nodes.name: Registry-only Owner Development Projection

source_of_truth.scope: read-only owner-facing projection from the validated canonical §3.5 Active Work Registry
source_of_truth.precedence: canonical §3.5 Registry only; DEV-REG-2 owns evidence reconciliation upstream

canonical_docs.role: canonical §3.5 Active Work Registry consumed after validation

notes: Read-only consumer; it does not write the Registry, runtime state, Airtable, caches, or persistence.
It does not own evidence authority or reconciliation authority and does not scan ROADMAP, BUG, CHANGE, AI_CONTEXT, git, PRs, or runtime evidence.
It preserves Work State and Evidence State as validated Registry fields; Current Stage and Next Decided Step are not parsed for status.
Supersedes the broader multi-source OC-C approach from PR #663 for this development-status projection.

nodes.name: Canonical Active Work Registry Reconciler

source_of_truth.scope: deterministic development/governance maintenance for explicitly keyed evidence reconciliation into canonical §3.5
source_of_truth.precedence: explicit structured evidence only; the Registry remains the canonical summarized status and this routine does not infer identity or Work State

canonical_docs.role: canonical §3.5 Active Work Registry written by this bounded routine

notes: Development/governance maintenance only; deterministic and no LLM or network dependency.
Accepts exact Initiative Key mappings from structured evidence manifests; no title similarity or broad prose search.
May write only allowed machine-managed §3.5 fields and never changes Work State, identity, Scope, Horizon, Current Stage, or Next Decided Step.
Does not own runtime state, does not participate in application runtime, and does not prove deployment/runtime from commit subjects or CI success.

nodes.name: Canonical Active Work Registry Validator

source_of_truth.scope: development/governance validation of the canonical §3.5 Active Work Registry structure and semantic invariants
source_of_truth.precedence: canonical §3.5 Registry plus this read-only validator; validation output is not Registry state or runtime evidence

notes: Read-only development/governance validator; it does not own runtime state.
It does not reconcile evidence, write §3.5, or participate in runtime Core Reasoning.
It validates required columns, closed vocabularies, booleans, provenance, and cross-field invariants for the canonical Registry.

nodes.name: Tools

source_of_truth.scope: tool identity, policy metadata, dispatch, provider result normalization, and evidence validation
source_of_truth.precedence: tool_registry policy plus dispatcher/provider code and executable tests on main

production_evidence.scope: dated repository briefing of tool/evidence behavior; current production mode must be rechecked

notes: Permission, availability, dispatch, approval, and evidence validation are separate boundaries.
Unknown or ambiguous tool identity must fail closed.
A display string is never execution evidence.

edges.notes: Registry policy identifies approval-required tools; lifecycle stays in ActionContracts.
Tool metadata cannot become business or approval truth.
